## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.09.2026 - 06.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Ryan Shook_, 06.09.2026, 2/5: "I honestly really like FitAI and use it every day, but this billing issue is frustrating. I paid $108.11 for a yearly plan in 2024. In 2025, FitAI offered me a ~$30 yearly promo, which I accepted. I later discovered my original plan had also renewed for $108.11, leaving me with two overlapping yearly subscriptions on the same Google account. I never intended to pay for two annual plans at once. I’ve contacted support and hope they resolve it."
<!--/ir-theme-->
